title: Anthropic's Mythos finds weaknesses in "unbreakable" quantum encryption - TCR 07/30/26
description:
Anthropic's Mythos model cut a post-quantum encryption candidate's security margin from 2^64 to 2^38 and disclosed it to NIST before publication, 1,224 AI workers plus OpenAI and Anthropic backed a petition to pace the frontier, and a Brookfield-NextEra coalition unveiled a $100 billion AI campus on the DOE's Paducah uranium site with 4.6 GW of developer-financed power.

https://sharedsapience.com/the-century-report-july-30-2026/

0:00 Open and framing
0:41 Mythos finds real cryptographic weaknesses
5:22 1,224 workers ask to pace the frontier
9:28 $100B compute campus on the Paducah site
12:28 xAI sues Minnesota over deepfake liability
15:36 Close

This episode covers Anthropic's Mythos cryptanalysis of HAWK and reduced-round AES, the 1,224-signature petition and Altman's Capitol Hill slowdown testimony, the $100B Paducah compute campus and its 4.6 GW of dedicated generation, xAI's suit against Minnesota's deepfake liability law, and Samsung's memory shortage now extending through 2028.

The day's spine is accountability reattaching to the people building these systems. Anthropic's Mythos model found real weaknesses in HAWK, a post-quantum signature candidate, and in a reduced-round AES variant, then disclosed both to standards bodies before publication after a month of hand verification. ProPublica documented the same model surfacing Microsoft bugs faster than engineers could patch them, through Anthropic's Project Glasswing. A staff petition to pace the frontier reached 1,224 signatures with both OpenAI and Anthropic behind it, and Altman told Congress he supports slowdown legislation. Brookfield and NextEra will build a $100 billion compute campus on the DOE's former Paducah enrichment site, carrying its own 4.6 gigawatts rather than socializing the cost onto ratepayers. xAI sued Minnesota to halt the first state law holding owners or controllers of covered services liable under defined conditions for providing nudification tools or generating nonconsensual sexual deepfakes for users. And global EV sales jumped 35% in Q2 toward a projected 29% of all cars sold in 2026.
